title: Record edit dialog: choosing a section tab scrolls the dialog element itself, pushing the title and the tab bar out of view with no way back
body:
repo:hotcrm#2 · sunhaolin · session_local1adc6fb3954245ba8940a3719cdaea98

Filing gate: ① product defect with a reproduction. Source: fleet (found in a maintainer-ordered local UI test pass of the HotCRM app on 2026-11-26; filed through the pm-dispatch relay on the maintainer's instruction).
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · severity: Impeded · reach: every sectioned object form opened in a dialog on a viewport shorter than the form · evidence: measured on the released 18.6.0 packages (2026-11-18), zh-CN console; not re-measured on main

## 维护者速读
- 做什么：编辑弹窗里点分区页签时，只滚动表单内容区，不能把整个弹窗滚走。
- 谁受益：所有在弹窗里编辑多分区记录的用户。
- 不做会怎样：点一下页签，弹窗标题和页签栏就被顶出屏幕且滚不回来，只能关掉重开。
- 需要你做的：无，分诊定级即可。

## What

The record edit dialog draws a sectioned object form with a section tab bar. Choosing a tab scrolls the target section into view, and the scroll lands on the `[role=dialog]` element instead of the form's own scroll area. The dialog's computed `overflow-y` is `hidden`, so it shows no scrollbar and the wheel cannot scroll it back.

Measured after one click on a later section tab, viewport 768 px tall: dialog `scrollTop` 188, `scrollHeight` 877, `clientHeight` 689. The dialog title and the tab bar are above the visible area.

## Reproduction

1. Open a record whose object form has several sections (HotCRM: an opportunity) and choose Edit, so the form opens in a dialog.
2. Click a section tab that is not the first.
3. Result: the title and tab bar leave the dialog's visible area; scrolling inside the form does not bring them back. Closing and reopening is the only recovery.

## Acceptance

- Choosing a section tab scrolls only the form body; the dialog element's `scrollTop` stays 0, and the title, the tab bar and the footer buttons stay visible.
- Holds for a viewport shorter than the form and for the mobile layout.
- A test asserts the dialog's `scrollTop` after a section tab click.

Dedupe (open and closed): `dialog scroll section tab`, `edit dialog scrollIntoView` 0 hits.
Batch-of: local UI deep test pass 2026-11-26, 14 cards (5 in hotcrm, 9 in objectstack).
Blocked-by: none.
